Updated Fri, September 4, 2026 at 8:56 PM UTC

UFO expert and Capitol Hill Presser Joshua Golembeske has reportedly mentioned that the movie Disclosure Day might not be a coincidence because the film shows a clear story backed by government documents. Similarly, the Pentagon's release of UAP or UFO files did not surprise the astrophysicist Dr. Eric Davis.

Golembeske recently mentioned in a statement to News nation said that the government has been hiding the truth for a long time. He mentioned,

"The movie doesn't seem like a coincidence, but it may be, and the movie paints a very clear picture that these documents back up."

The expert further said that this process seems connected to disclosure efforts to help the public understand what is happening. He explained that the basics of this subject were already shown in the film in which a specific species is mentioned.

He explained that over the past three years, Congress has already heard sworn testimony from whistleblowers, insiders, former military officers, and national security professionals. They claimed that aliens were being kept in storage and that reverse engineering was already underway.

Joshua Golembeske opened up about Disclosure Day's alien coverup theme

Joshua Golembeske called Disclosure Day's alien coverup theme more than a coincidence. He said,

"The movie doesn't seem like a coincidence, but it may be, and the movie paints a very clear picture that these documents back up, that there's a long-running government coverup."

He explained that advanced technology has been reverse engineered, and this process of portraying aliens appears to be a part of the film so that the government can help people understand what is happening. He said that the basics of this subject were already reflected in the movie that introduced a particular race of beings.

Golembeske sets a clear example of the government's attempt to reverse engineer exotic technology

The Capitol Hill Presser recalled that the famous UFO program titled Project Blue Book was designed to make the public dismiss the subject as nonsense. However, he stressed that the U.S. government secretly treated the matter with great seriousness. He revealed that crash retrieval missions were carried out by the government to reverse engineer advanced technology. Golembeske said,

"There were crash retrieval operations where they were attempting to reverse engineer exotic technology."

Golembeske explained that even though most of these UFO documents may appear dry and the footage may seem inconclusive, important details are hidden by the government. According to the documents, these efforts included the government's attempts to study anti-gravitic propulsion systems.

As per News Nation, he gave an example of a CIA document number 19, which was later declassified. He urged everyone to read it because it contained an assessment from the Australian Department of Defence that described how the U.S. government and military had been concealing this phenomenon for a long time.
